description: This file defines the Loader class within the OpenCart system, responsible for loading controllers, models, views, languages, libraries, configs, and helpers, and managing their interactions and event triggers.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A class responsible for dynamically loading and managing controllers, models, views, languages, libraries, configs, and helpers within the OpenCart framework, with event triggering and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Loader with a Registry object.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Overloads property access to retrieve objects from the registry.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Overloads property setting to store objects in the registry.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Loads and executes a controller method based on a route, with event triggers before and after execution.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Loads a model, wraps it in a proxy, and stores it in the registry.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Renders a view template with data, with pre- and post-render event triggers.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Loads language data for a route, with event triggers.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Loads a library object, with error handling if loading fails.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Loads configuration data for a route, with event triggers.

methods.name: helper
methods.description: Includes helper PHP files based on route, with error handling.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Creates a callable that invokes a model method with event triggers and error handling.
